zh: 胡萝卜蛋糕：一种加入切碎的胡萝卜的蛋糕，通常由面粉、油、鸡蛋、糖、胡萝卜和香料制成，顶部覆盖着奶油芝士糖霜。
en: a sweet food made from carrots, flour, sugar and eggs mixed together and baked

en: a skilled and trained cook who works in a hotel or restaurant, especially the most important cook
ex: Harry doesn’t want to be a star chef when he’s 20.

en: a food made with eggs that have been mixed and fried, often with other foods added
ex: He can make fantastic soups and salads, excellent omelettes and the best cakes.

zh: 番茄汤：一种被制成光滑浓稠液体的汤，通常含有奶油。
en: a usually hot, liquid food made from tomatoes and other vegetables
ex: This time he makes tomato soup, some salad, steak and carrot cake.

zh: n. 沙拉，色拉，沙律（一种常加调味汁的凉拌食物）

ex: He can make fantastic soups and salads, excellent omelettes and the best cakes.

en: a thick, flat piece of meat
ex: This time he makes tomato soup, some salad, steak and carrot cake.

en: the meat of a chicken
the meat of a cow

zh: 羔羊，小羊；羊羔肉；<非正式>宝贝，乖乖
en: the meat of a young sheep

zh: 汉堡包，夹心牛肉饼；（类似汉堡包的）馅饼
en: meat or other food pressed into a round, flat shape and fried
a long curved fruit with a yellow skin

en: a round, sweet fruit with a thick orange skin and a centre that is divided into many equal parts

zh: 苹果；苹果树；苹果公司（Apple Inc.）
en: a hard, round fruit that has a green or red skin and is white inside
a small, red fruit with a green leaf at the top and small, brown seeds on its surface

zh: 马铃薯，土豆，洋芋；马铃薯植株；<英，非正式>（尤指脚后跟部的）袜子破洞
en: a round vegetable with a brown, yellow, or red skin that grows in the ground
a long, thin orange vegetable that grows in the ground
ex: This time he makes tomato soup, some salad, steak and carrot cake.

en: a soft, round, red fruit eaten in salad or as a vegetable
ex: OK, first we need to add the tomato sauce.

en: a hollow green, red or yellow vegetable
ex: Can I cut the peppers for you?

zh: 咖啡（饮品）；一杯咖啡；咖啡豆或咖啡粉；咖啡色；咖啡树；（Coffee）人名，（英）科菲
en: a hot drink made from dark beans which are made into a powder
a hot drink that you make by pouring water onto dried leaves

zh: （牛或羊等的）奶；奶汁，母乳；乳液（用于清洁或保护皮肤）；（椰子等植物的）白色汁液
en: a white liquid produced by cows and other female animals

zh: 橙汁：从橙子榨取的汁液，通常作为饮品饮用，也可指市售的瓶装或鲜榨橙汁（通常作不可数名词，指一杯或一份时可数）。
en: the liquid that comes from oranges
a basic food made by mixing flour, water and sometimes yeast
a pale yellow food made from cream that you put on bread or use in cooking

zh: 谷类食物；谷类植物，谷物

zh: （鸟类的）卵，蛋；（尤指用作食品的）蛋，鸡蛋；卵子，卵细胞；<非正式>人，家伙
en: an oval object with a hard shell which is produced by female birds, especially chickens, and which is eaten as food
something such as an apple or orange that grows on a tree or a bush, contain seeds, and can be eaten as food

zh: 蜂蜜；亲爱的，宝贝儿；<非正式>极好的事物
en: a sweet, sticky food that is made by bees

en: a sweet food made with fruit and sugar that you can put on bread

zh: 烤面包片，吐司；干杯，祝酒，敬酒；极受敬慕的人（或事物）

en: a thick, liquid food with a slightly sour taste which is made from milk
